cues: Opens with "I'll proceed with the methodology as described in the skill guide" and refers to "the 10-step The plan procedure", so it names a methodology explicitly.

The numbered sections follow a fixed template: Classification/Constraints, Dependencies, Key decisions, first end-to-end slice, Phases, Validation checks, Cross-Cutting Concerns, AI Layer, Exceptions, Deferred.
Uses specialized jargon: reversibility tiers R1/R2/R3, gate IDs V0–V4 with hypothesis/method/threshold/evidence/consumer fields, "Point of no return", and "Exceptions: None".
Ends with a Self-Check checklist that restates methodology principles ("Rework runs widest first", "Exposure runs smallest first", "Each gate has 5 fields, a phase, and a consumer").
References "Principle 7 order" in the AI Layer section, and tags budgets as ASSUMPTION or REQUIREMENT. Both show it is applying a prescribed rulebook.
